purpose: Evidence-ready working file for LORE Crypto History.
progress_note: 13 core/canonical 2024 events verified. Deep-cut research still to add: German government BTC sales, Bhutan mining/holdings, meme-coin/Pump.fun cycle, Polymarket, TON/Telegram games and selected hacks/tokenization milestones.

entries.title: SEC approves US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded products
entries.summary: The US Securities and Exchange Commission approved exchange rule changes allowing multiple spot Bitcoin exchange-traded product shares to list and trade. The products began public trading on 11 January.
entries.significance: After more than a decade of rejected applications, spot Bitcoin ETP approval opened a direct regulated securities-market channel for US investors to gain Bitcoin price exposure.

sources.title: SEC — Statement on Spot Bitcoin ETP Approval

entries.title: US spot Bitcoin ETPs begin trading with about $4.6 billion first-day volume
entries.summary: The newly approved US spot Bitcoin ETPs commenced public trading on 11 January 2024 and collectively recorded about $4.6 billion of first-day trading volume.
entries.significance: The launch converted the long ETF battle into a live institutional market and immediately created some of the most heavily traded new crypto investment products.

sources.title: SEC-filed issuer disclosure on first-day spot Bitcoin ETP trading

entries.title: Ethereum Dencun activates blobs and proto-danksharding
entries.summary: Ethereum's Cancun-Deneb upgrade activated at epoch 269,568 and introduced EIP-4844 blob transactions for cheaper temporary rollup data storage.
entries.significance: Dencun materially reduced data costs for Ethereum layer-2 rollups and was the biggest execution/scaling upgrade between Shapella and Pectra.

entries.title: BlackRock launches BUIDL tokenized fund on Ethereum
entries.summary: BlackRock unveiled the BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund, BUIDL, its first tokenized fund issued on a public blockchain, using Ethereum and Securitize infrastructure.
entries.significance: BUIDL became a flagship bridge between traditional asset management and public-blockchain tokenization of cash and Treasury-style assets.

entries.title: Bitcoin completes its fourth halving at block 840,000
entries.summary: Bitcoin block 840,000 was mined on 20 April 2024, reducing the block subsidy from 6.25 BTC to 3.125 BTC.
entries.significance: The fourth halving again cut new Bitcoin issuance in half and coincided exactly with the activation of the Runes protocol.

entries.title: Runes protocol activates at Bitcoin block 840,000
entries.summary: Casey Rodarmor's Runes fungible-token protocol activated at block 840,000, the same block as Bitcoin's fourth halving; hundreds of runes were etched in the activation block.
entries.significance: Runes created a Bitcoin-native fungible-token system integrated with Ordinals tooling and triggered a new burst of competition for Bitcoin blockspace.

entries.title: Hong Kong launches Asia's first spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs
entries.summary: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing welcomed six spot virtual-asset ETFs covering Bitcoin and Ether to trading on 30 April 2024.
entries.significance: Hong Kong became a major Asian regulated market for spot Bitcoin and Ether exchange-traded products, including Ether products months before US trading began.

sources.title: HKEX — Asia's First Spot Virtual Asset ETFs

entries.title: SEC approves exchange rule changes for US spot Ether ETPs
entries.summary: The SEC granted accelerated approval to proposed rule changes from NYSE Arca, Nasdaq and Cboe BZX to list and trade shares of Ether-based exchange-traded products.
entries.significance: The decision extended the regulated US spot-crypto ETP framework beyond Bitcoin to Ether and cleared the principal exchange-listing hurdle for spot Ether products.

entries.title: DMM Bitcoin loses 4,502.9 BTC
entries.summary: Japanese exchange DMM Bitcoin reported an unauthorized outflow of 4,502.9 BTC, valued at roughly 48.2 billion yen at the time.
entries.significance: The loss was one of Japan's largest cryptocurrency thefts since Coincheck and became another major exchange-custody failure.

sources.title: Reuters — DMM Bitcoin reports 4,502.9 BTC loss

entries.title: Mt. Gox begins Bitcoin and Bitcoin Cash repayments to creditors
entries.summary: The Mt. Gox rehabilitation trustee began repayments in Bitcoin and Bitcoin Cash through designated exchanges in July 2024, more than a decade after the exchange collapsed.
entries.significance: The repayments finally returned crypto assets to thousands of creditors from the defining exchange failure of Bitcoin's early history.

sources.title: Mt. Gox Trustee — July 5 repayment notice

entries.title: WazirX loses more than $230 million in multisig-wallet cyberattack
entries.summary: WazirX disclosed a cyberattack on an Ethereum multisig wallet using Liminal infrastructure, resulting in theft of digital assets exceeding $230 million and the suspension of withdrawals.
entries.significance: The attack became one of the largest crypto thefts in Indian market history and severely impaired the exchange's ability to match customer token balances.

entries.title: US spot Ether ETPs begin trading
entries.summary: Spot Ether exchange-traded products, including Grayscale ETHE and ETH, began trading on US national securities exchanges on 23 July 2024 after registration statements became effective.
entries.significance: Ether joined Bitcoin as a crypto asset available through live US spot exchange-traded products, deepening institutional access to the second-largest blockchain asset.

sources.title: Grayscale SEC filing — ETHE/ETH begin trading

entries.title: Bitcoin trades above $100,000 for the first time
entries.summary: Bitcoin crossed the $100,000 level for the first time on 5 December 2024.
entries.significance: Six figures became one of Bitcoin's most symbolic price milestones, arriving in the same year as US spot ETP launches and the fourth halving.
entries.notes: Exact intraday high depends on exchange/index; card copy should use the threshold rather than one universal all-time-high figure.
